facts.fact: 抉择摊牌开场：「你无法爱我的任何部分」vs「这些日子是我存在中最好的部分」；她心知「无论哪条路我都要失去其中一个」；他不在乎旁人听见
facts.anchor: These weeks with you have been the best parts of my existence.

facts.fact: Marked 报复恐惧：她说出「Marked Match 会杀死与 Marked 相守之人」——他逐字回敬「我、谁、都、不怕」；「I've let you manage this how you're comfortable」
全有宣言：「要就要全部的你——有没有印记都一样」；「If it were up to me, I'd take you to my ship right now and keep you for myself」
facts.anchor: I want you, all of you…with or without a mark.

facts.fact: 勇气句：她请他离开（声音先于勇气消失）；「I don't want to leave…I won't leave」；「We are from two different continents, Draven Artrayu!」哭腔收场
facts.anchor: “Draven? I think you have to leave.”

facts.fact: 恐惧自白：「我没怕过东西——现在怕了；我 Marked、守了这份希望一生，不知怎么像你应得的那样放你进来」；他抱住她——「Draven might have the power to hold me together」
facts.anchor: I don’t know how to let you in like you deserve…like I want to,

facts.fact: 入屋章：他替她解剑带、蹲下解靴（His gentleness warms me）；湿衣下的金褐色皮肤（这个季节不该有）；「Never be sorry for touching me again. Not a question—a demand」+「I am yours, even if you choose not to want me later」
facts.anchor: I am yours, even if you choose not to want me later.

facts.fact: 门口吻至打住：她喊停「This can't go further than a kiss」——额头相抵、时间静止；「That was more than just a kiss」；「Thank you…For not pushing further」（敬意与克制双双在场）
facts.anchor: “That was more than just a kiss.”
